Goal: Dynamic Form with Staged Replacement
We're implementing a flicker-free dynamic form system for the Cognition Chrome extension. Here's what we're building and why:
The Problem
Current: When users change a dropdown (like provider selection), the entire form rebuilds with `innerHTML = ''`, causing visible flicker and losing user state
Bad UX: Form flashes, user loses focus, has to re-select previous choices
The Solution: Staged Replacement
Render new form hidden alongside the old one
Atomic swap: Show new, hide old instantly (zero flicker)
Clean up: Remove old DOM after swap
Preserve state: Form values and focus maintained through tree properties
Technical Architecture
Data Flow:



Key Components:
tree-to-dom. js: Captures `formData` and `focusedElement` in events, handles `focus: true` in tree nodes
ui. js: Single `showModal()` method that always does staged replacement (works for first-time and updates)
inference. js: Uses captured form state to rebuild tree with preserved values
Current Status
✅ Enhanced `tree-to-dom` to capture focus in `createEventData()`
✅ Added `focus: true` handling in tree nodes
🔄 Working on: `ui. showModal()` staged replacement implementation
❌ Failing tests: `elements["modal-overlay"]` is undefined
Next Steps
The `showModal()` implementation needs debugging - the tree-to-dom transform isn't returning the expected elements object structure. Once this works, we'll test with the inference provider form and extend the pattern to other dynamic forms (TTS settings, etc.). This establishes the foundation for professional, flicker-free UI that scales to complex multi-step forms and real-time controls. I also moved a lot of stuff out of the UI module including some other stuff in the TTS and STT or so that I could look at the functionality in those in those two modules and then notice how they now contain similarly out of place code for rendering search and put stuff in the UI module I want to extrapolate that out and essentially allow for these module based functionality to modules to inject functionality into certain places and I guess that certain place right now is the UI module search input bar
